title: CHICKEN BROILED IN PAPER
instructions: --Split a chicken and let it soak for two hours in oil mixed with parsley, sliced onion,  cloves,  salt and pepper. Put each half in papers, enclosing all the seasoning and broil over a very slow fire. When done take off the paper, bacon, etc., and serve with sauce a la ravigotte.
